notes.title: New content available!
notes.content:
This update adds new content to the game. In addition to new girls and puzzles, the game also earns 4 new achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39128512/c58f648b8fd1a417b56c3caf9bf19734d734701c.jpg[/img]

All art in the game is amateur, made by a beginner, but talented artist. I thank everyone who is leaving their feedbacks, we will bring even better arts in the next game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39128512/ea077a67b230c9bf21751dbd58264a0cbac5b7de.jpg[/img]

thanks!

notes.title: Hot Hentai Puzzle vol.1 - v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]A new game mode was added in version 1.1.0.[/h1]

Now the game contains two types of puzzle, a classic Jigsaw puzzle in which you have to join pieces to assemble an image and a new mode in which you must change blocks of place to assemble the image.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39128512/63116b58373d0e4743fb5c2abf36eb6b90a3f9c4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39128512/2a80d80f00cca001a117c7b827a59fadc52b5792.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who is buying and reviewing the game, I am happy that so many people are having fun and relaxing with the game.

Regards,
Hot Puzzle Studio.
